name: Cooperative Laws & Multi-State Cooperative Societies (MSCS) Act
overview: Guidelines and member rights under the Multi-State Co-operative Societies (MSCS) Act 2002 and 2023 amendments, governing transparency, election procedures, and democratic member control in Indian agricultural cooperatives.
member_rights: Right to vote: One member, one vote principle regardless of share capital held.
Right to inspect books: Right to examine annual audited balance sheet, profit and loss statement, and member register.
Right to participate in Annual General Meeting (AGM): Must be convened within 6 months of close of financial year.
Right to share in cooperative dividend and patronage bonus.
Right to file grievance with the Cooperative Ombudsman or Central Registrar.

agm_regulations.notice_period: Minimum 14 to 21 days written notice to all eligible members.
agm_regulations.quorum: As specified in bylaws (typically 1/5th of total active voting members).
agm_regulations.mandatory_agenda: Adoption of audit report, election of board directors, approval of annual budget, dividend declaration.

dispute_redressal.authority: Arbitrator appointed by Central Registrar of Co-operative Societies (CRCS).
